'''Glyptodon''' is an [[extinct]] genus of giant [[armadillo]]s from the ice age, introduced in the [[Release_information/53.15|Dino Update]] along with other [[Creature#Extinct|prehistoric creatures]].

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] glyptodons for their ''thick, bony armor plates''.
